name: High School Days
source:
Takashi Sakamoto follows his father's job appointment and transfers from a high school in Saitama to Hokkaido. What kind of exciting youth adventures are bound to happen to him there?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
坂本隆志因父亲工作调动，从埼玉县的一所高中转学到北海道。在那里，等待他的会是怎样激动人心的青春冒险？

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
